title: Easter at King’s: Beethoven — Missa Solemnis
summary: King's College, Cambridge commemorates, to the day, the bicentenary of the death of Beethoven with his greatest work. |  | Friday 26 March 2027 | 7:30 pm | Philharmonia Chorus | BBC Concert Orchestra | Daniel Hyde | Conductor | Beethoven | Missa Solemnis, Op. 123 | This concert will be broadcast on BBC Radio 3 | The Philharmonia Chorus and BBC Concert Orchestra with conductor Daniel Hyde bring to life the monumental | Missa Solemnis | on the bicentenary of Beethoven’s death on 26 March 1827. Regarded by the composer as his greatest work, this colossal sacred canvas pushes the boundaries of human emotion and choral architecture. It evokes the mystery and wonder of God through an equally unfathomable musical narrative. Join us for a once-in-a-generation commemoration
